experiment_data.hypothesis: The convergent entry-exit routing architecture (instruction-dominant attention heads, counterfactual sensitivity, cross-instruction classification) observed in OpenVLA (Llama-2) and TraceVLA (Phi-3) generalizes to a third architecture family — NORA (Qwen2.5-VL-3B, 36 layers, GQA). This three-model convergence elevates the claim from 'two-model pattern' to 'architecture-independent phenomenon' of VLA fine-tuning.
